slides.headline: The most beautiful trip of my life almost started with no suitcase.
slides.subhead: What nobody tells you about lost luggage.
slides.altText: [PHOTO TBD] — a single suitcase on an empty airport carousel, editorial tone

slides.sceneText: I got to check-in calm. Bags checked, boarding was easy. I landed seven hours later — my bag didn't land with me.
The first reaction is panic. The second is the question nobody wants to ask: now what, for the next 48 hours, with none of what I packed?
slides.altText: [PHOTO TBD] — detail shot of an airline service counter

slides.subject: The most common mistake when your bag doesn't show up
criteria: Leaving the airport without filing a formal report
Not keeping the receipt and tracking number
Not asking about an essentials kit on the spot
slides.forWhom: Anyone in a rush to leave the airport
slides.notForWhom: Anyone who understands the first 15 minutes shape everything that follows

slides.sceneText: The turn wasn't the bag showing up. It was realizing I'd packed the essentials in my carry-on — and that changed how I actually lived those two days.
slides.altText: [PHOTO TBD] — open carry-on bag with essentials laid out

routeSteps.action: File the irregularity report before leaving the baggage claim area
Keep every receipt and the tracking number
Ask directly about an emergency kit or reimbursement for essentials
Confirm the official follow-up channel (app, phone, or airline email)

slides.ruleText: Deadlines for filing a lost-luggage claim and reimbursement policy vary by airline and country. [VERIFY SOURCE AND DATE]

slides.item: Reimbursement for essentials in case of lost luggage
slides.note: Every airline has its own policy — always confirm directly with the airline when it happens, not from someone else's story.

slides.ctaText: Has this happened to you? Tell us in the comments what saved the trip.
